corrections.name: Final Pose
corrections.why: The current Evasive reference describes two Power Up Evasives as available for CaCs, and an independent Xenoverse 2 skill-ID corpus marks Final Pose as a CaC skill. Its individual page identifies Recoome as a notable cast user, which does not by itself make it cast-exclusive.

corrections.name: Mach Dash
corrections.why: The current Evasive reference states the two Power Up Evasives are available for CaCs, and the independent skill-ID corpus marks Mach Dash as a CaC skill.

corrections.name: Punisher Guard
corrections.why: Punisher Guard is the current name for Vanisher Guard. The current Other Evasives category includes Punisher Guard, while the skill-ID corpus marks Vanisher Guard as a CaC skill. Therefore the renamed/current record should retain CaC availability.

reconciliation.note: The broader Evasive Skill page currently says eight Other Evasives are available for CaCs, but the current category has 11 entries and Backflip is explicitly a Time Patroller skill. The category plus individual page and skill-ID evidence support nine CaC-accessible Other Evasives. Preserve the source-count discrepancy rather than forcing the eight-count.
